decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range has long lifecycles in architectural hardware and costs little to keep listed.
A multi-model handle family supports the firm's system breadth and is still early in its specification lifecycle.
A single design carries some rationalisation risk, but four years is short for door hardware and keeping it costs little.
A single handle design close to the established offer is cheap to maintain, and projects specified by architects still draw on it.
A handle family covering several models and budget levels fits the firm's strategy and is likely to remain in the catalogue.
The flagship electronic access system is central to the firm's move toward digital building organisation and would more likely be updated than withdrawn.
